label: Activity supplier API requests
purpose: API requests GTE sends to activity, excursion and ticket ('service') suppliers: availability, cancellation-policy and booking calls, with results and passengers requested, outcome and response-time band. Very low volume (about 2,200 requests a year).
grain: Supplier API requests aggregated per request day and hour (UAE time and CET), customer, supplier connection, request type, outcome, destination zone, service date, passenger mix, response-time band and interface.
use_for: number of API requests sent to activity suppliers by day, month, supplier or customer
results returned per availability request by activity suppliers
outcomes (correct / no results) and response-time bands
demand by destination and requested activity date
not_for: hotel supplier traffic (Statistics History Supplier, Statistics Hotel Supplier)
transfer supplier traffic (Statistics Supplier API Transfer)
requests customers send to GTE (Statistics Client API Service)
average response time in seconds (the measure is broken; use response-time bands)
today's traffic (no real-time cube for these suppliers)

coverage.note: Rolling window of about one year ending yesterday (2025-10-17 to 2026-10-15 when read on 2026-10-16); 2025-10 and the current month are partial. Sparse: about 2,200 requests in the whole year, so monthly figures are small. Service dates run into 2027-01.

dates.label: Request date (UAE time)
dates.meaning: Day the request was sent to the activity supplier, in UAE time (UTC+4). The cube's main date.

dates.label: Request date (CET)
dates.meaning: request_date_cet = the request date in Central European time (2 hours behind UAE in summer, 3 in winter). Use only when CET is asked.

dates.label: Activity date
dates.meaning: Date of the activity/excursion asked for in the request; can be months in the future. Some requests have no service date.

measures.name: [Requests]
measures.label: Activity supplier API requests
measures.definition: Number of API requests GTE sent to activity suppliers (availability, booking, cancellation and similar calls).
measures.notes: Main measure. Very low volume (a few requests a day).

measures.name: [Results]
measures.label: Results returned by activity suppliers
measures.definition: Options returned by the activity suppliers; only availability requests return results.
measures.notes: Verified: booking and cancellation requests have 0 results.

measures.name: [Avg Results]
measures.label: Average results per activity supplier request
terms: average results per activity supplier request
measures.notes: Diluted by booking/cancellation calls (0 results): filter 'Request Types'[Request Type] = "Availability" for results per search.

measures.name: [Total Pax Number]
measures.label: Passengers requested from activity suppliers
measures.definition: Passengers in the requests sent to activity suppliers; only availability requests carry passengers.
measures.notes: A passenger searched several times is counted each time.

measures.name: [Avg Pax Number]
measures.label: Average passengers per activity supplier request
measures.definition: [Total Pax Number] / [Requests] over all request types.
terms: average passengers per activity supplier request
measures.notes: Diluted by booking/cancellation calls (0 pax): filter Request Type = "Availability" for passengers per search. The cube's own format shows 0 decimals.

measures.name: [Avg Response Time Sec]
measures.label: Average supplier API response time
measures.definition: Meant to be the average supplier response time in seconds.
measures.hidden_reason: broken scale: values are 1000 times too small (requests in the '1 - 2' second band average 0.001, the '9 - 10' band 0.009). Use [Requests] by 'Range Times'[Range Time] for response times.

measures.name: [Total Cached Requests]
measures.label: Cached activity supplier requests
measures.definition: Requests answered from cache instead of the supplier API.
measures.hidden_reason: always 0: no cached request is recorded ('Cached'[Cached] is "No" for every request).

measures.name: [% Cached Requests]
measures.label: Activity supplier cache rate
measures.hidden_reason: always 0: no cached request is recorded.

breakdowns.label: Supplier code
breakdowns.meaning: Supplier connection code: how supplier-side cubes identify a supplier. Only two connections have data.

breakdowns.label: Supplier connection
breakdowns.meaning: Name of the supplier connection (not the same naming as the Bookings cube).

breakdowns.label: Request type
breakdowns.meaning: Kind of API call sent to the supplier; almost all are Availability.

breakdowns.label: Outcome
breakdowns.meaning: Result of the request. Only 'Correct' and 'No results' occur in the data.

breakdowns.label: Response-time band
breakdowns.meaning: Supplier response time band in seconds ('0 - 1' ... '10 - 11', '> 10', 'Timeout'); sort by its order column. The reliable way to describe response times in this cube.

breakdowns.label: Passenger mix
breakdowns.meaning: Passenger mix of the request, probably adults - children ('2 - 0' = 2 adults; note '2 -1' is stored without a space); other mixes are 'Other'.

breakdowns.label: Destination area
breakdowns.meaning: Area (city/region/country) of the destination searched.

breakdowns.label: Destination zone
breakdowns.meaning: Destination zone searched (143 thousand values: filter or take a top N).

breakdowns.label: Customer
breakdowns.meaning: Customer (agency) whose search triggered the supplier request.

breakdowns.label: Customer market
breakdowns.meaning: Commercial market of the customer.
sample_values: GCC - Except UAE and Local Residence

breakdowns.label: Customer category
breakdowns.meaning: Customer category.

breakdowns.label: Agency group
breakdowns.meaning: Customer's agency (pricing) group.

breakdowns.label: Master agency
breakdowns.meaning: Parent agency of the customer.

breakdowns.label: Integrator
breakdowns.meaning: Technology integrator the customer connects through ('n/a' for direct web customers).

breakdowns.label: Customer country
breakdowns.meaning: Country of the customer.

breakdowns.label: Interface
breakdowns.meaning: Customer channel that triggered the request: WEB (almost all) or CLC; no XML traffic.

breakdowns.label: Hour (UAE time)
breakdowns.meaning: Hour of day of the request, UAE time ('00'-'23').

breakdowns.label: Hour (CET)
breakdowns.meaning: Hour of day of the request, Central European time ('00'-'23').

breakdowns.label: Weekday
breakdowns.meaning: Day of week of the request ('Monday' ... 'Sunday').

breakdowns.label: Month
breakdowns.meaning: Month of the request, e.g. 'September 2026'.

breakdowns.label: Quarter
breakdowns.meaning: Quarter of the request, e.g. 'Quarter 3, 2026'.

named_filters.name: activity supplier availability requests
named_filters.meaning: Availability searches sent to the suppliers.

named_filters.name: activity supplier cancellation requests
named_filters.meaning: Cancellation calls sent to the suppliers.

named_filters.name: slow activity supplier responses
named_filters.meaning: Responses of 10 seconds or more, or time-outs.

rules: This is supplier-side traffic (GTE -> activity, excursion and ticket ('service') suppliers). Requests customers send to GTE are in Statistics Client API Service; hotel supplier traffic is in Statistics History Supplier. Never mix them.
Very low volume (about 2,200 requests in a year from two supplier connections, often 0-10 a day): present figures as small counts and avoid strong conclusions from percentages on a few requests.
The cube keeps a rolling window of about one year that ends yesterday; there is no data for today or for periods older than about 365 days.

[Avg Response Time Sec] is hidden because its values are 1000 times too small. For response-time questions use [Requests] by 'Range Times'[Range Time] (sorted by its order column) and say the average is not reliable in this cube.
No request in this cube is cached ('Cached'[Cached] is always "No"); the cache measures are hidden. If asked about cache use, say none is recorded.
Results and passengers are only recorded on availability requests: for results or passengers per search, filter 'Request Types'[Request Type] = "Availability".
Only [Requests], [Results] and [Total Pax Number] add up; never sum or average [Avg Results] or [Avg Pax Number] across rows.

'Calendar' and 'Hours' are UAE time (UTC+4); 'Calendar CET' and 'Hours CET' are Central European time. Use the UAE pair unless CET is asked. 'Service Dates'[Service Date] is the requested service date (travel_date), not when the request was made.

Suppliers are identified by their connection code 'Suppliers'[Supplier Code] (always with 'Suppliers'[Supplier Code.UniqueName]); 'Suppliers'[Supplier] is the connection's name. The Bookings cube names suppliers differently: joining to Bookings is by name only and may not match well, so say so whenever you combine them.
Use the cube's measures only; never SUM a column.

review.question: [Avg Response Time Sec] in this cube is 1000 times too small (requests in the '1 - 2' second band average 0.001). Keep it hidden until the cube is fixed, or show it multiplied by 1000 as seconds?
review.why: As stored it reads 0.0002 s; a silent x1000 correction would become wrong the day the BI team fixes the measure. The response-time bands give a reliable picture meanwhile.

review.question: This cube only holds activity/excursion/ticket supplier connections (no hotels). Should it be labelled and used as the 'activity supplier API' cube?
review.why: The two connections with data are activity and excursion connections; hotel supplier traffic lives in Statistics History Supplier and Statistics Hotel Supplier.
